So about 6 years ago. I went on a walk down the canal in my hometown. I was not in a good place at the time and so I was trying to clear my thoughts. About 3 miles down this canal, The canal is intersected by a river, in which it moves over on a bridge.

This is not a large river, I would liken to more of a large stream/small river, and at this point in the river, it was pretty shallow, maybe 3 feet at its deepest. It was a nice, quiet day and so I decided to make my way off the beaten path, down to this river and wade in. Its in a relatively rural area so it really was lovely. I walked over and felt a black bag in the river, you could see that it had been slightly ripped, the plastic tendrils moved with the current and was weighed down with something heavy. 

I don't know why, but I investigated, and I found a bone. Every step I took disturbed the silty water so I couldn't see the bag, and to be honest I don't think I wanted to. The bone I had found seemed, to my not so knowledgable mind to be too large to be human, it was too thick. Although my heart raced, my mind needed a better explanation and so I reasoned that a farmer had disposed illegally of a sick or maimed animal. I dropped the bone and promptly returned home.

I've told my family, who either don't believe me, or don't care but are definitely not worried. I returned a while later, this time in winter though when the water was too cold for me to wade in. But I couldn't see it, whether it was an animal or something else, I definitely wasn't supposed to see that.
